observable.black: translation average over the 2N axis placements of the indicator that z-e and z+e lie in one occupied primal-NN cluster
observable.white: the exact same placement average for vacant endpoints connected in the white matching graph (NN plus diagonals)
observable.claim_boundary: finite-lattice local singlet rows; neither row is named as continuum energy

score.covariance: sample covariance of the 100 aligned batch P4 vectors divided by 100; sizes are independent blocks
score.promotion_gate: extend both sizes to 100k iff one fixed local row has absolute z at least 3 at both sizes and its common-ray chi-square is at least 4 lower than the A/E/C common-ray chi-square; otherwise stop
